plan.title: 물은 됐고요, 햇빛 찾으러 갑니다
plan.intent: Turn an exhausted worker's earnest care into a cute missing-plant mystery. Hold a small sincere worry before the insolently polite runaway note releases the tension as comedy.

facts.statement: Kang Siu returns tired from work and immediately prepares the watering can.
The succulent is absent from the window-side desk; an intact empty pink terracotta pot lies tilted amid dry soil.
A tiny pale-yellow sticky note on the overturned pot carries the plant's green handwritten departure message.

beats.action: Siu's tired return becomes his familiar caring routine, with dinner still untouched.
The empty pot interrupts his greeting and the loose watering can drips.
Worry drives Siu to search beneath the furniture.
Siu discovers and reads the note, replacing an accidental disappearance with a deliberate departure.
A stunned Siu recognizes that his plant has run away.

Keep the pale-yellow note prominent at the reveal. Use the reference wardrobe and room, with the absent succulent staying absent.

The later source disagrees about carrying the pot, so this scene depicts only the explicitly empty pink pot on the desk.

moments.action: A tired Siu slumps through the apartment doorway, loosened white shirt collar and briefcase beside him.
Siu stands by the window desk holding his watering can, greeting the usual succulent spot; an unopened sandwich sits nearby.
The intact tiny pink pot lies empty and tilted on the desk amid scattered soil.
A wide-eyed Siu freezes with water dripping from his lowered watering can.
Siu kneels on the floor with one hand beneath the bed, anxiously searching for the missing succulent.
Siu peels a tiny pale-yellow sticky note from the bottom of the overturned pink pot.
The yellow note fills the view, bearing a legible green handwritten departure message.
Siu holds the note near his stunned face, his alarm turning into absurd disbelief.

drawability.evidence: The final brief contains eight static drawable instants in one room, no physical reconstruction of the missing plant, three short human dialogue moments, and a separate physical-note reveal. Its last deadpan reaction pays off the mystery.

plan.title: 창가의 실세, 바질 선생
plan.intent: Reveal the houseplant as a sharp-tongued roommate. Siu's missing-plant panic collides with Basil's ventilation demands; the cold human and delighted herb provide the comic payoff before Siu earns a witness account.

facts.statement: The voice is Basil, a glossy broad-leaf herb in a soil-stained white rectangular planter beside the window.
Siu reports the disappearance; Basil says the succulent left by itself, which Siu finds absurd.
Basil complains about watering without ventilation and theatrically droops; Siu opens the windows.
Cold air chills Siu and revives Basil; Siu kneels to ask where the runaway went.

beats.action: The mocking voice resolves into Basil, whose immediate priority is fresh air.
Siu brandishes the note; Basil dismisses his panic by revealing voluntary departure, and Siu questions walking plants.
Basil exposes failed care and droops dramatically until Siu agrees to open the window.
Opening the window makes the papers flutter; shivering Siu and revived Basil show opposing reactions to the same draft.
Siu kneels before the planter and asks for the runaway's whereabouts.

plan.title: 햇빛을 찾아간 작은 발자국
plan.intent: Replace fear of loss with relief at the succulent's resourcefulness. Tiny soil tracks become a warm invitation to act: Siu leaves his tired evening behind and heads toward the rooftop, ending on curiosity rather than a new scare.

facts.statement: Basil witnessed the departure around half past eleven and points to the torn screen where dry soil remains.
A gray rain downpipe runs beside the second-floor window; small soil traces ascend its surface rather than descend.
Basil reports the succulent's rooftop sunlight destination; Siu is relieved that the missing plant chose to survive rather than wither.
Siu leaves the window open, wears striped slippers, switches on his phone flashlight and runs up the concrete stairs toward the rooftop.

beats.action: Basil's witness testimony directs Siu to the torn insect screen, shifting the search outside.
Siu locates the rainpipe and sees small upward soil marks, recognizing a climb instead of a fall.
Basil links the upward route to a rooftop garden offering sunlight.
Relief softens Siu as he recognizes the plant's deliberate pursuit of a livable place.
Siu entrusts the open-window room to Basil and turns toward the doorway.
In striped slippers and carrying his lit phone, Siu runs upstairs with renewed purpose.

visualReview.evidence: Eight clearly separated panels in four rows. Every selected Korean string is readable, with human and plant dialogue attached to the correct visible characters and inner narration in boxes. Ascending soil traces, warm relief and a lit-phone stair climb provide the intended causal ending. Inspected alongside the preceding page by the same host, not an independent reader.

findings.evidence: The pipe marks are stylized as small paw-like soil clusters rather than indistinct round root smudges. They still establish the small upward trail without showing a different creature.

The doorway panel gives Siu a shoulder bag, although the novel left his work bag at the entrance and does not describe retrieving it. This extra prop does not change the search or the final slippers-and-phone action.
The doorway view compresses room geometry and crops the window behind Basil. The planter remains elevated, but a future shared room master could keep that reverse angle clearer.
